purpose: Diagnostic source-only comparison for occurrence-level historical reading review. Predictions never enter primary text without a completed exact occurrence authority.

photius-bekker-legacy.citation: Photius, Bibliotheca, Immanuel Bekker, volume2 (Berlin1825), physical scans66/73, printed331/338.

prompt:
Transcribe only the large Greek authorial text in this scanned column strip.
Preserve polytonic accents, breathings, punctuation, headings and literal printed
word fragments. Standard Greek typographic ligatures may be written as their
constituent Greek letters; record no invented letters. Do not complete a word
cut at a column or strip boundary, expand an abbreviation, modernize spelling,
correct the printed text, translate or explain. Omit marginal reference numbers,
running headers, page numbers and smaller critical apparatus. Read down this
single column, preserving complete source lines as separate lines. Output only
the transcription.

review.pilot_policy: First one-column diagnostic finished with stop but had poor recognition; use shorter enlarged source strips, and retain all predictions as diagnostics rather than extra votes.
